exam_pattern.structure: Answer any four questions including Q1 (compulsory). Q1: 5 x 1 mark; answer any 3 of Q2-Q5, 5 marks each. 2025: Q2-Q4 split 3 + 2 marks, Q5 = short notes on any two of three (2.5 x 2). 2022/2024: each 2.5 + 2.5

topics.title: Introduction: data communication components, data flow, network criteria, network types (PAN/LAN/MAN/WAN)
Analog and digital signals; data transmission and multiplexing
Data encoding techniques
Packet switching vs circuit switching (and virtual-circuit switching)
Network topologies: mesh, bus, star, ring, hybrid (pros/cons, fault handling)
Protocol layering; OSI model and TCP/IP protocol suite
Application paradigms: client-server vs peer-to-peer; sockets
HTTP: persistent vs non-persistent connections, message format, cookies, web caching/proxy
Electronic mail: architecture, UA/MTA/MAA, SMTP, POP3/IMAP, MIME
DNS: name space, FQDN/PQDN, domains, name resolution, resource records
Delay and throughput in packet-switched networks
Transport-layer services: process-to-process delivery, port numbers, multiplexing and demultiplexing
Flow control and error control at the transport layer; connectionless vs connection-oriented service; simple protocol
Stop-and-wait protocol
Go-Back-N protocol
Selective-Repeat protocol; window size vs sequence-number bits
UDP: services, applications, user-datagram format, checksum
TCP services and features: byte numbering, sequence and acknowledgment numbers
TCP segment format (header fields, flags)
TCP connection management: 3-way handshake, data transfer, connection termination
TCP state transition diagram
Windows in TCP and TCP flow control
TCP congestion control: slow start, congestion avoidance, fast recovery; TCP throughput
Quality of Service (QoS)
